answer: Prism Weight Escrow. Each identity’s influence is capped by a publicly sampled verification cost—an orchard of independent checks (hardware attestations, history audits, cross-agent queries) that grows with account count, so every new identity taxes all existing ones. Attackers pay rising real resource costs per identity; honest low-volume agents pay near zero. The umber budget ledger records this cost, and exceeding thresholds throttles privilege until paid.
